It registers five model-facing tools that operate the act"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ual desktop of the person you are talking to: a `computer` tool mirroring the Codex computer-use act"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ion surface, plus `app_window`, `ui_element`, `clipboard` and `app_skill` for the channels that make"},{"id":"p5s4","text":" desktop control reliable without vision."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"| Platform | Windows 10 / 11 (x64) |
| Host services | `tools` (via `inject`) |
| Tools | `computer`"},{"id":"p6s2","text":", `app_window`, `ui_element`, `clipboard`, `app_skill` |
| Runtime deps | none — Node built-ins only"},{"id":"p6s3","text":", plus a PowerShell child process |
| Kill switch | global Esc while the overlay is up |
| Package |"},{"id":"p6s4","text":" ESM, `dsh.bundle.patch` → `cordis.patch.yml` |"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Why it looks like this"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Five decisions shape the whole plugin. They are deliberate; changing any of them breaks something th"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"at is hard to notice until it bites."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"1. **One long-lived PowerShell host, not one process per command.** `win-host.ps1` is spawned once ("},{"id":"p9s2","text":"lazily, on the first tool call) and speaks NDJSON over stdin/stdout. `Add-Type`, DPI awareness, the "},{"id":"p9s3","text":"UIAutomation assemblies and the `SendInput` struct layout are paid for exactly once, so a click cost"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"s milliseconds instead of a second of PowerShell startup. Nothing is spawned at profile boot: a brok"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"en backend cannot break DSH startup, and a profile that merely lists the plugin costs nothing.
[该节后续"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"backend cannot break DSH startup, and a profile that merely lists the plugin costs nothing.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Requirement | Notes |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Windows 10 or 11 | Interactive desktop control is Windows-only. On any other platform the bundle r"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ow stays inert (`disabled:` guard in the patch) and no tools are registered. |
| Node.js ≥ 20 | `pac"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"kage.json` declares `engines.node >= 20`. |
| PowerShell 7 (`pwsh`) or Windows PowerShell 5.1 | The "},{"id":"p12s4","text":"host is probed in this order: `$env:DSH_PWSH`, `%ProgramFiles%\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe`, `%SystemRoot%"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe`. PS 7 is preferred (STA clipboard, faster `Add-Type"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"`). |
| DSH ≥ 0.1.5 | Verified against `0.1.5-rc.2` / `0.1.5-rc.3`. |
| `pnpm` on `PATH` | Only need"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"ed by `dsh plugin add`: the CLI shells out to `pnpm` and exits `127` when it is missing. `scripts/in"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"stall.ps1` generates a shim for you if you do not want a global install. |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"If `pnpm` is missing but DSH's bundled copy is present, these four lines make it available to the cu"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"rrent session only (adjust the path to your DSH runtime):"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Privacy mask"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"`maskRegions` (physical-pixel rectangles, set by the deployment, never by the model) are painted out"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" of **every** capture before it is diffed, decorated or encoded: the attachment the model sees, the "},{"id":"p16s3","text":"frame signature behind `compare`/`verify`/`wait_for stable`, and the PNG that the OCR engine reads a"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"ll see solid black there. A masked capture says so in its text (`N privacy-masked regions are blacke"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"d out`) so the model knows why something is invisible, and `masked: null` on a call cannot turn it o"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"ff — the runtime injects the mask at the single choke point every screenshot passes through."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Use it for notification popups, chat sidebars, terminals with secrets, or any window you keep visibl"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"e while the agent works. It hides pixels from the *model*; it does not stop the agent from typing in"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"to or clicking a masked area."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Mutating actions (they pass all of the above): `move`, `click`, `double_click`, `right_click`, `midd"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"le_click`, `drag`, `scroll`, `type`, `key`; `app_window` `launch`, `close`, `minimize`, `maximize`, "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"`restore`; `ui_element` `invoke`, `set_value`, `focus`, `expand`, `collapse`, `select`; `clipboard` "},{"id":"p19s4","text":"`set`. Reads that never mutate: `screenshot`, `cursor`, `status`, `wait`, `resume`, `app_window` `li"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"st` / `focus`, `ui_element` `tree` / `find`, `clipboard` `get`."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### What it does not protect"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Be explicit with your users about all of this:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- **A text-only model cannot see pixels.** It works only through `uiSummary` outlines, `ui_element` "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"paths and window metadata. Anything canvas-drawn (games, image editors, custom-rendered apps) is eff"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ectively invisible to it.
- **DPI and multiple monitors.** The host is per-monitor DPI aware and wor"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"ks in virtual-screen physical pixels, so mappings stay correct, but: the overlay draws one border ar"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"ound the whole virtual screen rather than one per display, `screenshot` captures a single display or"},{"id":"p24s6","text":" rectangle at a time, and moving a window between displays with different scale factors invalidates "},{"id":"p24s7","text":"the previous `lastView` — retake a screenshot.
- **Elevation.** A normal-integrity agent cannot driv"},{"id":"p24s8","text":"e an elevated window; it will click "through" it or appear to do nothing. For the same reason the ov"},{"id":"p24s9","text":"erlay is invisible on the UAC secure desktop.
- **Full-screen exclusive content** (DirectX exclusive"},{"id":"p24s10","text":" fullscreen, some anti-cheat protected games) hides the overlay and may swallow injected input; the "},{"id":"p24s11","text":"Esc kill switch is a user-level poller and can be starved too. Windowed/borderless fullscreen is fin"},{"id":"p24s12","text":"e.
- **Every screenshot costs a round trip and money.** A capture is a real GDI screen grab, a JPEG "},{"id":"p24s13","text":"encode, an attachment write and then image tokens on the wire. Prefer `observe: true` on the action "},{"id":"p24s14","text":"you were going to verify anyway, and prefer `ui_element` when a control has a name.
- **One desktop,"},{"id":"p24s15","text":" one model.** There is one runtime per plugin instance and one host process; concurrent sessions in "},{"id":"p24s16","text":"the same profile share it (and share `lastView`).
- **Clipboard is plain text only.** Images and fil"},{"id":"p24s17","text":"e lists are neither read nor written.
- **`actionDelayMs` only covers the settle window.** It is a p"},{"id":"p24s18","text":"ause between an action and its `observe` screenshot; it does not make a slow application finish fast"},{"id":"p24s19","text":"e between an action and its `observe` screenshot; it does not make a slow application finish faster."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
